title: Quarto

inlines.v: QUART'O, noun [Latin quartus.] A book of the size of the fourth of a sheet; a size made by twice folding a sheet, which then makes four leaves. QUART'O, adjective Denoting the size of a book in which a sheet makes four leaves.
